mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patrol_target ( service_name, probe_type, target_endpoint, threshold_config, interval_cron, ai_agent_id, quiet_window_minutes, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{serviceName}, #{probeType}, #{targetEndpoint}, #{thresholdConfig}, #{intervalCron}, #{aiAgentId}, #{quietWindowMinutes}, #{status}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, service_name, probe_type, target_endpoint, threshold_config, interval_cron, ai_agent_id, quiet_window_minutes, status, last_check_time, last_check_status, last_error_msg, create_time, update_time FROM patrol_target WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, service_name, probe_type, target_endpoint, threshold_config, interval_cron, ai_agent_id, quiet_window_minutes, status, last_check_time, last_check_status, last_error_msg, create_time, update_time FROM patrol_target WHERE service_name = #{serviceName} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, service_name, probe_type, target_endpoint, threshold_config, interval_cron, ai_agent_id, quiet_window_minutes, status, last_check_time, last_check_status, last_error_msg, create_time, update_time FROM patrol_target WHERE status = 1

SELECT id, service_name, probe_type, target_endpoint, threshold_config, interval_cron, ai_agent_id, quiet_window_minutes, status, last_check_time, last_check_status, last_error_msg, create_time, update_time FROM patrol_target ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE patrol_target SET last_check_time = now(), last_check_status = #{lastCheckStatus}, last_error_msg = #{lastErrorMsg}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE patrol_target SET status = #{status}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
